id.description: Unique business-scoped identifier for the authenticated user identity.

email.description: Primary email address associated with the user identity.

email_verified.description: Whether the primary email address has been verified by the business.

phone_number.description: Primary phone number in E.164 format.

phone_verified.description: Whether the primary phone number has been verified by the business.

first_name.description: Given or first name of the user.

last_name.description: Family or last name of the user.

addresses.description: Saved postal addresses associated with the user identity.

links.description: Optional business links related to the user account or privacy policy.
